subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: When an explicitly configured `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` cannot resolve or bind its Tailscale address, should startup fail, or should the gateway remain available on loopback with prominent degraded-state diagnostics?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically safe from remote exposure, but they trade existing local availability against strict enforcement of the operator's requested reachability contract.

options.title: Visible loopback degradation
options.body: Keep the documented loopback fallback, but add prominent startup and status diagnostics that clearly report lost Tailnet reachability.

options.title: Fatal explicit Tailnet bind
options.body: Abort startup with a non-zero exit whenever an explicitly requested Tailnet listener cannot be established, accepting upgrade and transient-outage compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Visible loopback degradation
recommendation.body: Keep the documented loopback fallback, but add prominent startup and status diagnostics that clearly report lost Tailnet reachability.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available merged history on the gateway bind resolver and its startup-policy boundary.
